neighbours.label: The copula right after a sentence-opening 'That': 'That is why', 'That's the'
fire: We missed the train. That's why we were late.
She lost her keys. That is the whole story.
Nobody answered. That's what worried me.
He smokes a lot. That is why he coughs.
The shop is closed. That's the problem.
They argued all night. That is how it ended.
I saw the price. That's when I left.
The door was open. That is what I noticed.
quiet: We missed the train. The traffic was why we were late.
She lost her keys. The story is long.
Nobody answered. Silence is what worried me.
He smokes a lot. Tobacco is why he coughs.
The shop is closed. The owner is ill.
They argued all night, which is how it ended.
I saw the price, which is when I left.
The door was open, which is what I noticed.

predictions: ' is' or ''s after sentence-opening That fires. 'which is' and ' is' after a noun stay quiet.
